title: ReviewsEntitySplitPayload
description: reviews.entity.split v1 (OpenVibe.Reviews server/reviews/service.js split → entityEvent). An editor undid a merge (POST /api/v1/entities/:ref/split, capability reviews.entity.split, a person only), in the transaction of the split: the merged_into link (link_id) is ended, the entity is active again with exactly the aliases and signals it had before the merge, and both aggregates are recomputed. A summary of the former target that cites signals which went back with the split is flagged and gets a pending revision in the same transaction; Search gets both entities' documents again (reviews.index_document.upserted). The signal ids are left out (they are in the entity's history). Envelope: subject { type: entity, id: <split entity ent_…> }, visibility public, priority important, actor the editor (user usr_…).

entity_id.description: The entity split off again (subject.id); now state active.

from_entity_id.description: The entity it had been merged into.

link_id.description: The merged_into link this split ended (the link_id of the reviews.entity.merged event).

signal_count.description: Active signals back with the entity (its own and those of entities merged into it).

url.description: Canonical URL of the split entity's page (/e/<slug>).

from_url.description: Canonical URL of the former target's page; null only if that entity no longer exists.

note.description: The editor's note (clipped to 500 characters); null when none was given.
